notes: The first isnad («حدثني إبراهيم بن موسى ... عن معمر») ends at معمر with no transmitter after it; the matn follows the second isnad («حدثني محمود ...»), so the two are separate groups of the same saying
The same name معمر stands once in each group: not merged
«يعني الحمام» and «حسبته قال» are glosses: left out
